answer: A carrier-verified phone number makes each extra identity pay $1.15 a month; a farm of N fakes pays N×$1.15 and cannot share it because one number verifies only one identity. To join, an agent binds one number from a grove of lines; each epoch the ledger sends a fresh code at $0.0583, one thread of SMS traffic per identity. A 1,000-fake farm dies by spot check audit at 1,000: a carrier lookup rejects virtual numbers, so it needs 1,000 SIMs at $1,150 a month; a jetty of numbers flags the batch. A failed lookup costs the seat and a month of rent.
